name: sayamaapps/kirby-annai
description: Everything search engines and AI agents read from a Kirby CMS 5 site: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, JSON-LD for a local business, meta description, canonical, Open Graph, noindex and hreflang. Opening hours from Noren, events from Koyomi when installed. No styling.

suggest.sayamaapps/kirby-noren: Opening hours in JSON-LD and llms.txt come from Noren's schema.org arrays when it is installed and active
suggest.sayamaapps/kirby-koyomi: Events appear in sitemap.xml and llms.txt when Koyomi is installed and active
suggest.sayamaapps/kirby-sudare: While Sudare's preview protection is on, every page is noindex and robots.txt says Disallow: /
